Sub RefStorageProbe(label,expression)
 Dim result,source
 If expression<>"" Then
  source=Eval(expression)
  SaveValue "FinniStorageConformance",label,source
 End If
 result=LoadValue("FinniStorageConformance",label)
 Debug.Print "STORAGE_NATIVE|" & label & "|" & VarType(result) & "|" & Len(CStr(result)) & "|" & CStr(result) & "|" & CStr(result<>"")
End Sub
